description: Fresh download links for the footage a NightMarquee demo plays, every clip, without fetching the prompt again. Use it when the links from nightmarquee_get_prompt have expired. Save each file into public/ under its name before building. A free prompt's footage needs a free account and the rest need Unlimited (run nightmarquee_sign_in).
